context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the review-process instructions from the published Ruby Core Skills plugin.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Every review must classify findings using the standard severity levels (Critical, Major, Minor, Nitpick).

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: The reviewer must verify that the changeset includes tests for any new or modified logic.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Check scope creep: flag files changed that are unrelated to the PR's stated purpose.

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Authorisation:** Verify every action checks policy/permission — missing checks are Critical.

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Review Findings Report:** Present the structured table of findings categorized by severity.

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Re-Review Verification:** Once fixes are made, review the diff specifically addressing the findings and state the new status.
